sloka: तत्र अपि न्यवसत् रामः कंचित् कालम् अरिन्दमः ।अथ आश्रमस्थो विनयात् कदाचित् तम् महामुनिम् ॥३-११-२९॥
transliteration: tatra api nyavasat rāmaḥ kaṁcit kālam arindamaḥ ।atha āśramastho vinayāt kadācit tam mahāmunim ॥3-11-29॥

translations.english: On his arrival, Rama, the subduer of enemies, was honoured by the sages at the hermitage where he stayed for a short time.
